hints.content:
Function $\redD g$ is shifted $5$ units up relative to $\blueD f$. 



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A graph f and its transformed graph g on an x y coordinate plane. The x- and y- axes scale by one. Graph f is concave up from interval negative infinity to negative six and concave down from negative six to infinity. It passes through the point (negative three, negative two) and (negative one, negative three). Graph g is concave up from interval negative infinity to negative six and concave down from negative six to infinity. It passes through the point (negative three, three) and (negative one, two). A dashed arrow points from point (negative three, negative two) to the point (negative three, three).

hints.content: Therefore, to find $\redD{g(x)}$ you can find $\blueD{f(x)}$ and add $5$.

question.content:
$\redD g$ is a transformation of $\blueD f$. The graph below shows $\blueD f$ as a solid blue line and $\redD g$ as a dotted red line.


[[☃ image 1]]

** What is the formula of $\redD g$ in terms of $\blueD f$? **
